rules.rule_name: Sequential Sanction Record Reading
rules.rule_description: The system reads each sanction record sequentially from the Sanction Input File, extracting the provider NPI and sanction action type for processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
1:Sanction Input Processing
Read Next Sanction Record
Extract NPI, Action Code,
Reason & Effective Date

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Sanction Input File is open and contains one or more sanction records, each carrying a provider NPI and a sanction action type (Terminate, Suspend, or Reinstate)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system reads the next available sanction record from the Sanction Input File
acceptance_criteria.Then: The provider NPI and sanction action type are extracted from the record and made available for provider lookup and sanction processing; if no more records exist, the end-of-file condition is set and processing loop terminates

rules.rule_name: Provider Lookup by NPI
rules.rule_description: Before applying any sanction, the system must locate the provider in the Provider Master File using the NPI extracted from the sanction record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
2:Provider Lookup by NPI
Search Provider Master
Using NPI from Sanction Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: A sanction record has been successfully read and the provider NPI has been extracted from the sanction record
acceptance_criteria.When: The system searches the Provider Master File using the NPI from the sanction record as the lookup key
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the provider is found in the Provider Master File, the provider's master record is retrieved and made available for sanction application; if the provider is not found, the not-found handling process is triggered

rules.rule_name: Unmatched Provider NPI Handling
rules.rule_description: When a sanction record references an NPI that does not exist in the Provider Master File, the record is skipped and a warning is logged. No status update or notice is generated.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
3:Provider Not Found Handling
Log Unmatched NPI
Skip Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: A sanction record has been read from the Sanction Input File containing a provider NPI
acceptance_criteria.When: The system searches the Provider Master File and the NPI from the sanction record is not found
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system logs a warning message 'PRVSAN01: NPI NOT FOUND' along with the unmatched NPI value; no provider status update is performed; no sanction notice is generated; and processing continues with the next sanction record

rules.rule_name: Provider Termination Status Update
rules.rule_description: When a sanction action is of type Terminate, the provider's status is updated to Terminated in the Provider Master File and the termination counter is incremented.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
4:Provider Termination
Update Provider Status
to Terminated
Increment Termination Counter

acceptance_criteria.Given: A sanction record has been read, the provider NPI has been found in the Provider Master File, and the sanction action type is Terminate
acceptance_criteria.When: The system applies the termination sanction to the provider's master record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The provider's status in the Provider Master File is set to Terminated; the running count of terminated providers for this processing run is incremented by 1

rules.rule_name: Provider Suspension Status Update
rules.rule_description: When a sanction action is of type Suspend, the provider's status is updated to Denied in the Provider Master File, effectively blocking the provider from active participation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
5:Provider Suspension
Update Provider Status
to Denied/Suspended
Block Claims & Services

acceptance_criteria.Given: A sanction record has been read, the provider NPI has been found in the Provider Master File, and the sanction action type is Suspend
acceptance_criteria.When: The system applies the suspension sanction to the provider's master record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The provider's status in the Provider Master File is set to Denied/Suspended; the provider is no longer considered active; the termination counter is not incremented

rules.rule_name: Provider Reinstatement Status Restoration
rules.rule_description: When a sanction action is of type Reinstate, the provider's status is restored to Active in the Provider Master File, reversing any prior suspension or termination.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
6:Provider Reinstatement
Update Provider Status
to Active
Restore Provider Eligibility

acceptance_criteria.Given: A sanction record has been read, the provider NPI has been found in the Provider Master File, and the sanction action type is Reinstate
acceptance_criteria.When: The system applies the reinstatement sanction to the provider's master record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The provider's status in the Provider Master File is set to Active; the provider's eligibility to participate is fully restored; the termination counter is not incremented

rules.rule_name: Provider Master Record Persistence After Sanction
rules.rule_description: After any sanction action (Terminate, Suspend, or Reinstate) is applied to a provider's record, the updated record must be immediately saved back to the Provider Master File.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
7:Provider Master Record Update
Persist Updated Provider Status
Back to Provider Master File

acceptance_criteria.Given: A sanction action (Terminate, Suspend, or Reinstate) has been applied to a provider's master record and the provider's status field has been updated in memory
acceptance_criteria.When: The system completes the status update for the provider
acceptance_criteria.Then: The updated provider master record is written back to the Provider Master File, persisting the new status; this occurs for every successfully applied sanction regardless of sanction type

rules.rule_name: Sanction Notice Program Selection and Invocation
rules.rule_description: After a provider's status is updated, the system dynamically selects and invokes the appropriate notice program based on the sanction action type, passing the full provider master record to the notice program.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
8:Sanction Notice Generation
Invoke Appropriate Notice Program
TRM / SUS / RST
Notify Claims & MCO Systems

acceptance_criteria.Given: A provider's master record has been successfully updated with a sanction action and saved to the Provider Master File
acceptance_criteria.When: The system determines the appropriate notice program to invoke based on the sanction action type: Terminate maps to suffix 'TRM', Suspend maps to suffix 'SUS', Reinstate maps to suffix 'RST', and any other action maps to suffix 'GEN'; the notice program name is constructed by combining the standard notice prefix with the determined suffix
acceptance_criteria.Then: The dynamically constructed notice program is invoked with the full provider master record as input so that downstream systems (Claims, MCO) are notified of the provider status change

rules.rule_name: Notice Program Not Found Handling
rules.rule_description: If the dynamically constructed notice program cannot be found or invoked, a warning is logged and processing continues without stopping. The provider status update already saved is not reversed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Notice Sent Successfully
to Downstream Systems / Log: Notice Program
Not Found - Skip Notice

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has constructed a notice program name and attempted to invoke it with the provider master record
acceptance_criteria.When: The notice program cannot be found or is unavailable for execution
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system logs a warning message 'PRVSAN01: NOTICE PGM NOT FOUND' along with the name of the missing notice program; the provider status update that was already saved to the Provider Master File is retained and not rolled back; processing continues with the next sanction record

rules.rule_name: Termination Count Summary Reporting
rules.rule_description: At the end of the processing run, the system reports the total number of providers that were terminated during this execution.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
9:Termination Count Reporting
Display Total Providers
Terminated This Run

acceptance_criteria.Given: All sanction records in the Sanction Input File have been processed and the end-of-file condition has been reached
acceptance_criteria.When: The system completes the sanction processing loop and closes all files
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays the summary message 'PRVSAN01: PROVIDERS TERMINATED=' followed by the total count of providers whose status was set to Terminated during this processing run; only Terminate actions contribute to this count, not Suspend or Reinstate actions

rules.rule_name: Sequential Processing of Sanction Input Records
rules.rule_description: The system must read and process each sanction record one at a time from the Sanctions Input File in sequential order, continuing until all records have been processed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Read Next Record from Sanctions Input File

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Sanctions Input File is open and contains one or more sanction records pending processing
acceptance_criteria.When: The system is ready to process the next sanction action
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system reads the next available sanction record sequentially from the Sanctions Input File and makes it available for further processing; this cycle repeats for every record in the file until no more records remain

rules.rule_name: Detect End of Sanctions File and Stop Processing
rules.rule_description: When all sanction records have been read from the Sanctions Input File, the system must recognize the end-of-file condition and stop the sanction processing loop, proceeding to final reporting.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: End of Sanctions File?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is reading records sequentially from the Sanctions Input File
acceptance_criteria.When: The system attempts to read the next record and the Sanctions Input File signals that there are no more records (end-of-file condition is detected)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the end-of-file indicator to TRUE, exits the sanction processing loop, closes both the Sanctions Input File and the Provider Master File, displays the total count of terminated providers, and ends the program run

rules.rule_name: Extract Provider NPI from Sanction Record
rules.rule_description: When a sanction record is successfully read, the system must extract the Provider NPI from the sanction record to identify which provider the sanction action applies to, enabling the subsequent lookup of that provider in the Provider Master File.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Extract Sanction Record Details:
- Provider NPI
- Action Code
  Terminate / Suspend / Reinstate
- Reason
- Effective Date

acceptance_criteria.Given: A sanction record has been successfully read from the Sanctions Input File and the end-of-file condition has not been reached
acceptance_criteria.When: The system extracts the details from the sanction record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system extracts the Provider NPI (National Provider Identifier) from the sanction record and uses it as the key to locate the corresponding provider record in the Provider Master File for subsequent status update

rules.rule_name: Validate Sanction Action Code as TERMINATE
rules.rule_description: The system must evaluate the action code on each sanction record to determine the appropriate provider status change. When the action code is TERMINATE, the system identifies the provider as subject to termination.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Validate Action Code

acceptance_criteria.Given: A sanction record has been read and the corresponding provider has been located in the Provider Master File
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the action code on the sanction record and the action code is TERMINATE
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system identifies the sanction action as a termination, sets the provider's status to TERMINATED in the Provider Master File, increments the termination counter by 1, saves the updated provider record, and proceeds to generate a termination notice

rules.rule_name: Validate Sanction Action Code as SUSPEND
rules.rule_description: The system must evaluate the action code on each sanction record to determine the appropriate provider status change. When the action code is SUSPEND, the system identifies the provider as subject to suspension.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Action Code: SUSPEND
Provider to be Suspended

acceptance_criteria.Given: A sanction record has been read and the corresponding provider has been located in the Provider Master File
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the action code on the sanction record and the action code is SUSPEND
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system identifies the sanction action as a suspension, sets the provider's status to DENIED in the Provider Master File, saves the updated provider record, and proceeds to generate a suspension notice

rules.rule_name: Validate Sanction Action Code as REINSTATE
rules.rule_description: The system must evaluate the action code on each sanction record to determine the appropriate provider status change. When the action code is REINSTATE, the system identifies the provider as subject to reinstatement.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Action Code: REINSTATE
Provider to be Reinstated

acceptance_criteria.Given: A sanction record has been read and the corresponding provider has been located in the Provider Master File
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the action code on the sanction record and the action code is REINSTATE
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system identifies the sanction action as a reinstatement, sets the provider's status back to ACTIVE in the Provider Master File, saves the updated provider record, and proceeds to generate a reinstatement notice

rules.rule_name: Pass Validated Sanction Record for Provider Lookup and Status Update
rules.rule_description: After the Provider NPI is extracted from a sanction record, the system must use that NPI to look up the provider in the Provider Master File. Only providers found in the Provider Master File are eligible to have a sanction applied; unrecognized providers are skipped with a warning.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Pass Record for Provider Lookup & Update

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Provider NPI has been extracted from the sanction record and is ready for lookup
acceptance_criteria.When: The system attempts to locate the provider in the Provider Master File using the extracted NPI as the search key
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the provider is found in the Provider Master File, the system proceeds to apply the sanction action (Terminate, Suspend, or Reinstate) and update the provider's status; if the provider is NOT found in the Provider Master File, the system logs a warning message identifying the unrecognized NPI, skips the sanction application and notice generation for that record, and continues to the next sanction record

rules.rule_name: Extract NPI from Sanction Record as Provider Lookup Key
rules.rule_description: The National Provider Identifier (NPI) present in the incoming sanction record must be extracted and used as the unique search key to locate the corresponding provider in the Provider Master File before any sanction can be applied.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Extract NPI from Sanction Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: A sanction record has been successfully read from the Sanction Input File and contains a National Provider Identifier (NPI)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to look up the provider in the Provider Master File
acceptance_criteria.Then: The NPI value from the sanction record is set as the search key to query the Provider Master File, ensuring the correct provider record is targeted for retrieval

rules.rule_name: Query Provider Master File Using NPI
rules.rule_description: The system must search the Provider Master File using the NPI extracted from the sanction record to retrieve the provider's current record, including their existing enrollment status, prior to applying any sanction action.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Use NPI as Search Key to Query Provider Master File

acceptance_criteria.Given: The NPI from the sanction record has been set as the search key
acceptance_criteria.When: The system queries the Provider Master File using that NPI
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Provider Master File is searched for a matching provider record using the NPI as the unique identifier, and the result determines whether processing continues with a sanction update or routes to not-found handling

rules.rule_name: Route to Sanction Processing When Provider Record is Found
rules.rule_description: When the Provider Master File lookup using the NPI is successful and the provider record exists, the system must retrieve the provider's current record with all existing status details and route processing to apply the sanction action.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Provider Record Found in Master File?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Provider Master File has been queried using the NPI from the sanction record
acceptance_criteria.When: A matching provider record is found in the Provider Master File
acceptance_criteria.Then: The provider's current record including existing enrollment status details is retrieved and made available, and processing is routed to the Apply Sanction step to update the provider's status

rules.rule_name: Log Warning and Skip Processing When Provider NPI is Not Found
rules.rule_description: When the Provider Master File lookup fails to find a provider matching the NPI from the sanction record, the system must log a warning message identifying the unrecognized NPI and skip all further processing for that sanction record — no status update and no notice generation will occur.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Provider NPI Not Found in Master File

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Provider Master File has been queried using the NPI from the sanction record
acceptance_criteria.When: No matching provider record is found in the Provider Master File for the given NPI
acceptance_criteria.Then: A warning message is logged stating 'NPI NOT FOUND' along with the specific NPI value from the sanction record, no provider status update is performed, no notice is generated, and processing moves on to the next sanction record

rules.rule_name: Provider Existence Validation Before Sanction Processing
rules.rule_description: Before applying any sanction action, the system must verify that the provider identified by the NPI in the sanction record exists in the Provider Master File. Only providers that are found in the master file are eligible for sanction processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Was Provider Found in Provider Master?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A sanction record has been read from the Sanction Input File containing a provider NPI
acceptance_criteria.When: The system attempts to look up the provider NPI in the Provider Master File
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the provider NPI is found in the Provider Master File, the provider record is retrieved and made available for sanction processing; if the provider NPI is not found, all sanction actions for that record are skipped including no status update and no notice generation

rules.rule_name: Unmatched Provider NPI Warning Log
rules.rule_description: When a provider NPI from the sanction input file cannot be matched to any record in the Provider Master File, the system must log a warning message that identifies the unresolved NPI value so that it can be investigated and resolved.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Log Unmatched NPI PRVSAN01: NPI NOT FOUND Record the Unresolved NPI Value

acceptance_criteria.Given: A sanction record has been read from the Sanction Input File containing a provider NPI
acceptance_criteria.When: The provider NPI lookup in the Provider Master File returns no matching record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system logs a warning message in the format 'PRVSAN01: NPI NOT FOUND' followed by the specific NPI value from the sanction record that could not be matched

rules.rule_name: Skip Sanction Processing for Unmatched Provider
rules.rule_description: When a provider NPI from the sanction input cannot be found in the Provider Master File, no sanction actions of any kind are performed for that record. This means the provider status is not changed and no notice is generated, ensuring that sanctions are only applied to verified, existing providers.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Skip All Sanction Actions for This Record No Status Update No Notice Generated

acceptance_criteria.Given: A sanction record has been read from the Sanction Input File and the provider NPI has been looked up in the Provider Master File
acceptance_criteria.When: The provider NPI is not found in the Provider Master File
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system does not update any provider status in the Provider Master File, does not generate or send any notice for that sanction record, and proceeds directly to read the next sanction record from the Sanction Input File

rules.rule_name: Identify Termination Sanction Action
rules.rule_description: When processing a sanction record, the system must evaluate the sanction action type and route to termination processing only when the action is explicitly identified as TERMINATE.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Sanction Action Identified as TERMINATE

acceptance_criteria.Given: A sanction record has been read from the Sanction Input File and the corresponding provider has been found in the Provider Master File
acceptance_criteria.When: The sanction action type on the sanction record is TERMINATE
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system identifies this as a termination action and proceeds to update the provider's status to Terminated in the Provider Master Record

rules.rule_name: Update Provider Status to Terminated
rules.rule_description: When a sanction action is identified as TERMINATE, the provider's enrollment status in the Provider Master Record must be changed to Terminated, effectively ending the provider's active participation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Update Provider Status to Terminated in Provider Master Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: A sanction record with action type TERMINATE has been matched to an existing provider in the Provider Master File using the provider's NPI
acceptance_criteria.When: The termination sanction is being applied to the provider's master record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The provider's status field in the Provider Master Record is set to TERMINATED, overriding any prior status (Active, Denied, or otherwise)

rules.rule_name: Increment Termination Counter for Each Terminated Provider
rules.rule_description: Each time a provider is successfully terminated during the sanction processing run, the program's running count of terminated providers must be incremented by exactly 1 to support end-of-run reporting.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Increment Termination Counter by 1

acceptance_criteria.Given: A provider's status has just been set to Terminated in the Provider Master Record as a result of a TERMINATE sanction action
acceptance_criteria.When: The termination status update is applied
acceptance_criteria.Then: The termination counter is increased by exactly 1, accumulating the total number of providers terminated during the current processing run

rules.rule_name: Persist Terminated Provider Status to Provider Master File
rules.rule_description: After the provider's status has been updated to Terminated and the termination counter has been incremented, the updated Provider Master Record must be permanently saved back to the Provider Master File to ensure the termination is recorded.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Save Updated Provider Record to Provider Master

acceptance_criteria.Given: The provider's status in the in-memory Provider Master Record has been set to Terminated and the termination counter has been incremented
acceptance_criteria.When: The sanction update for the current provider is complete
acceptance_criteria.Then: The updated Provider Master Record — containing the new Terminated status — is written back to and permanently stored in the Provider Master File, replacing the previous record for that provider NPI

rules.rule_name: Identify Suspension Sanction Action
rules.rule_description: Determine whether the current sanction record carries a Suspend action, which triggers the provider suspension workflow.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Sanction Action = Suspend?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A sanction record has been read from the Sanction Input File and the corresponding provider has been located in the Provider Master File
acceptance_criteria.When: The sanction action on the record is evaluated
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the sanction action is Suspend, the provider suspension process is initiated; if the sanction action is any other type (Terminate or Reinstate), the suspension process is skipped and the appropriate alternative action is taken instead

rules.rule_name: Set Provider Status to Denied/Suspended
rules.rule_description: When a Suspend sanction action is identified, the provider's status in the Provider Master Record must be updated to Denied, effectively blocking the provider from receiving claims or services.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Provider Status to Denied/Suspended in Provider Master Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: A sanction record with a Suspend action has been matched to an existing provider in the Provider Master File
acceptance_criteria.When: The Suspend sanction action is confirmed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The provider's status field in the Provider Master Record is set to Denied/Suspended, marking the provider as ineligible to receive claims or services

rules.rule_name: Save Updated Provider Suspension Status to Provider Master File
rules.rule_description: After the provider's status has been set to Denied/Suspended in memory, the updated record must be immediately persisted back to the Provider Master File to ensure the change is recorded and effective.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Save Updated Provider Status to Provider Master File

acceptance_criteria.Given: The provider's status in the Provider Master Record has been updated to Denied/Suspended
acceptance_criteria.When: The sanction update has been applied to the in-memory provider record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The updated Provider Master Record is written back and saved to the Provider Master File, making the suspension status permanent and visible to downstream systems

rules.rule_name: Invoke Suspension Notice Program to Notify Downstream Systems
rules.rule_description: After a provider's suspension status has been saved, a dedicated Suspension Notice Program must be called to generate and dispatch a suspension notice, ensuring the provider and relevant downstream systems are informed of the suspension.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Invoke Suspension Notice Program - SUS Notify Downstream Systems

acceptance_criteria.Given: The provider's status has been successfully updated to Denied/Suspended and saved to the Provider Master File
acceptance_criteria.When: The suspension sanction action has been fully applied and persisted
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system dynamically builds the Suspension Notice Program name by combining the standard notice prefix with the suffix 'SUS', calls that notice program passing the full Provider Master Record, and if the notice program cannot be found or executed, a warning is logged identifying the missing program name, but processing continues without interruption

rules.rule_name: Identify Reinstatement Sanction Action
rules.rule_description: Determines whether the current sanction record carries a Reinstate action, which triggers the provider eligibility restoration workflow.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Sanction Action is Reinstate?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A sanction record has been read from the Sanction Input File and the provider NPI has been successfully located in the Provider Master File
acceptance_criteria.When: The sanction action type on the sanction record is evaluated
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the sanction action is Reinstate, the provider reinstatement workflow is initiated; if the sanction action is any other type (Terminate or Suspend), the reinstatement workflow is bypassed and the appropriate alternate sanction workflow is followed instead

rules.rule_name: Restore Provider Status to Active on Reinstatement
rules.rule_description: When a Reinstate sanction action is identified, the provider's status in the Provider Master Record must be updated to Active, restoring the provider's eligibility to participate.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Provider Status to ACTIVE in Provider Master Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: A sanction record with a Reinstate action has been matched to an existing provider in the Provider Master File
acceptance_criteria.When: The Reinstate sanction action is applied to the provider's master record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The provider's status field in the Provider Master Record is set to ACTIVE, overriding any prior Terminated or Denied status and restoring the provider's eligibility

rules.rule_name: Persist Reinstated Provider Status to Provider Master File
rules.rule_description: After the provider's status has been updated to Active in memory, the updated record must be immediately saved back to the Provider Master File to make the reinstatement permanent and visible across systems.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Save Updated Provider Status to Provider Master File

acceptance_criteria.Given: The provider's status in the Provider Master Record has been set to ACTIVE following a Reinstate sanction action
acceptance_criteria.When: The updated provider master record is written back to the Provider Master File
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Provider Master File is updated with the provider's new Active status, and the reinstatement is permanently recorded; the updated record reflects the restored eligibility of the provider

rules.rule_name: Select Reinstatement Notice Program Using RST Suffix
rules.rule_description: For a Reinstate sanction action, the system must identify the correct notice program by assigning the suffix 'RST' and combining it with the standard notice program prefix to form the full notice program name.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Select Reinstatement Notice Program - RST

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Reinstate sanction action has been successfully applied and the provider's status has been saved as Active in the Provider Master File
acceptance_criteria.When: The notice program name is being constructed for the reinstatement notification
acceptance_criteria.Then: The notice suffix 'RST' is selected and combined with the standard notice program prefix to form the complete reinstatement notice program name; for Terminate actions the suffix is 'TRM', for Suspend actions the suffix is 'SUS', and for any other unrecognized action the suffix defaults to 'GEN'

rules.rule_name: Invoke Reinstatement Notice Program with Provider Details
rules.rule_description: The dynamically constructed reinstatement notice program must be called and passed the full provider master record so that the notice program can use provider details to generate and send reinstatement notifications.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Invoke Reinstatement Notice Program Passing Provider Details

acceptance_criteria.Given: The reinstatement notice program name has been constructed using the 'RST' suffix combined with the standard notice program prefix
acceptance_criteria.When: The reinstatement notice program is invoked
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system calls the constructed notice program and passes the complete Provider Master Record (including provider NPI, status, and all provider details) to the notice program so it can generate the appropriate reinstatement notification

rules.rule_name: Log Warning When Reinstatement Notice Program Is Not Available
rules.rule_description: If the reinstatement notice program cannot be found or invoked, the system must log a warning identifying the missing program name. Processing must continue without interruption — the provider's Active status update is not reversed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Log: Reinstatement Notice Program Not Available

acceptance_criteria.Given: The reinstatement notice program has been constructed and an attempt has been made to invoke it with the provider's master record
acceptance_criteria.When: The notice program cannot be found or successfully invoked
acceptance_criteria.Then: A warning message is logged displaying 'PRVSAN01: NOTICE PGM NOT FOUND' along with the name of the notice program that could not be found; the provider's Active status update already saved to the Provider Master File is retained and not reversed; processing continues to the next sanction record

rules.rule_name: Send Reinstatement Notifications Upon Successful Notice Program Invocation
rules.rule_description: When the reinstatement notice program is successfully invoked with the provider's details, the notice program is responsible for generating and sending reinstatement notifications, completing the provider eligibility restoration process.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Send Reinstatement Notifications to Claims & MCO Systems

acceptance_criteria.Given: The reinstatement notice program has been successfully found and invoked with the complete Provider Master Record
acceptance_criteria.When: The reinstatement notice program executes using the provider details passed to it
acceptance_criteria.Then: The reinstatement notice program generates and sends the appropriate reinstatement notifications using the provider details from the Provider Master Record, completing the provider eligibility restoration process

rules.rule_name: Set Provider Status to Terminated When Terminate Sanction is Applied

rules.sub_graph_node_text: Provider Status Set to Terminated

acceptance_criteria.Given: A provider record has been located in the Provider Master File using the NPI from the sanction input record, and the sanction action type is Terminate
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the sanction action type and identifies it as a Terminate action
acceptance_criteria.Then: The provider's status on the Provider Master Record is set to Terminated

rules.rule_name: Set Provider Status to Denied/Suspended When Suspend Sanction is Applied
rules.rule_description: When a sanction action of type Suspend is applied to a provider, the provider's status in the Provider Master record must be updated to Denied before the record is persisted.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Provider Status Set to Denied/Suspended

acceptance_criteria.Given: A provider record has been located in the Provider Master File using the NPI from the sanction input record, and the sanction action type is Suspend
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the sanction action type and identifies it as a Suspend action
acceptance_criteria.Then: The provider's status on the Provider Master Record is set to Denied (Suspended)

rules.rule_name: Set Provider Status to Active When Reinstate Sanction is Applied
rules.rule_description: When a sanction action of type Reinstate is applied to a provider, the provider's status in the Provider Master record must be restored to Active before the record is persisted.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Provider Status Set to Active

acceptance_criteria.Given: A provider record has been located in the Provider Master File using the NPI from the sanction input record, and the sanction action type is Reinstate
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the sanction action type and identifies it as a Reinstate action
acceptance_criteria.Then: The provider's status on the Provider Master Record is set to Active

rules.rule_name: Persist Updated Provider Status to Provider Master File
rules.rule_description: After the provider's status has been updated in memory based on the sanction action (Terminated, Denied, or Active), the updated provider record must be written back and saved to the Provider Master File to make the change permanent.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Write Updated Provider Record Back to Provider Master File

acceptance_criteria.Given: A provider's status has been updated in the Provider Master Record based on the applied sanction action (Terminate sets status to Terminated, Suspend sets status to Denied, Reinstate sets status to Active)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system completes the status update on the provider record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The updated Provider Master Record is written back to the Provider Master File, permanently saving the new provider status

rules.rule_name: Proceed to Sanction Notice Generation After Successful Provider Record Update
rules.rule_description: Once the updated provider record has been successfully written back to the Provider Master File, the system must immediately proceed to generate and send the appropriate sanction notice to the provider.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Proceed to Sanction Notice Generation

acceptance_criteria.Given: The updated Provider Master Record reflecting the applied sanction action (Terminated, Denied, or Active status) has been written back to the Provider Master File
acceptance_criteria.When: The Provider Master File record update is completed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system proceeds to the Sanction Notice Generation process, passing the updated Provider Master Record to generate the appropriate notice corresponding to the sanction type applied

rules.rule_name: Determine Notice Program Based on Sanction Action Type
rules.rule_description: When a sanction is applied to a provider, the system must determine the appropriate notice program to invoke based on the type of sanction action (Termination, Suspension, Reinstatement, or Other/Unknown).
rules.sub_graph_node_text: What is the Sanction Action Type?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A sanction action has been successfully applied to a provider record and the provider master record has been updated
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the sanction action type from the sanction input record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system selects the corresponding notice program suffix: 'TRM' for Termination, 'SUS' for Suspension, 'RST' for Reinstatement, and 'GEN' for any other or unknown sanction type

rules.rule_name: Select Termination Notice Program Suffix
rules.rule_description: When the sanction action type is Termination, the system assigns the notice program suffix 'TRM' to identify the correct termination notice program to be invoked.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Select Termination Notice Program Suffix: TRM

acceptance_criteria.Given: A sanction record has been processed and the sanction action type is identified as Termination
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the sanction action type and matches it to Termination
acceptance_criteria.Then: The notice program suffix is set to 'TRM' to be used in building the full notice program name

rules.rule_name: Select Suspension Notice Program Suffix
rules.rule_description: When the sanction action type is Suspension, the system assigns the notice program suffix 'SUS' to identify the correct suspension notice program to be invoked.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Select Suspension Notice Program Suffix: SUS

acceptance_criteria.Given: A sanction record has been processed and the sanction action type is identified as Suspension
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the sanction action type and matches it to Suspension
acceptance_criteria.Then: The notice program suffix is set to 'SUS' to be used in building the full notice program name

rules.rule_name: Select Reinstatement Notice Program Suffix
rules.rule_description: When the sanction action type is Reinstatement, the system assigns the notice program suffix 'RST' to identify the correct reinstatement notice program to be invoked.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Select Reinstatement Notice Program Suffix: RST

acceptance_criteria.Given: A sanction record has been processed and the sanction action type is identified as Reinstatement
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the sanction action type and matches it to Reinstatement
acceptance_criteria.Then: The notice program suffix is set to 'RST' to be used in building the full notice program name

rules.rule_name: Select General Notice Program Suffix for Unknown Sanction Type
rules.rule_description: When the sanction action type does not match any of the known types (Termination, Suspension, or Reinstatement), the system assigns the default general notice program suffix 'GEN'.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Select General Notice Program Suffix: GEN

acceptance_criteria.Given: A sanction record has been processed and the sanction action type does not match Termination, Suspension, or Reinstatement
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the sanction action type and finds no specific match
acceptance_criteria.Then: The notice program suffix is set to 'GEN' as the default general notice program identifier

rules.rule_name: Build Full Notice Program Name from Prefix and Suffix
rules.rule_description: After the appropriate suffix is determined based on the sanction action type, the system constructs the full notice program name by combining the standard notice program prefix with the selected suffix.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Build Full Notice Program Name Prefix + Suffix

acceptance_criteria.Given: The notice program prefix is available and the notice program suffix has been determined based on the sanction action type (TRM, SUS, RST, or GEN)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system builds the full notice program name
acceptance_criteria.Then: The full notice program name is constructed by concatenating the notice program prefix with the selected suffix, resulting in a complete program name (e.g., prefix + 'TRM', prefix + 'SUS', prefix + 'RST', or prefix + 'GEN')

rules.rule_name: Invoke Notice Program with Provider Record for Downstream Notification
rules.rule_description: Once the full notice program name is built, the system invokes the notice program passing the complete provider master record so that downstream systems such as Claims and MCO receive the appropriate sanction notification.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Invoke Notice Program Passing Provider Record to Downstream Systems Claims & MCO

acceptance_criteria.Given: The full notice program name has been successfully constructed and the provider master record contains the updated sanction status
acceptance_criteria.When: The system invokes the dynamically built notice program
acceptance_criteria.Then: The notice program is called with the full provider master record as input, enabling downstream systems including Claims and MCO to receive and process the sanction notification

rules.rule_name: Handle Successful Notice Program Invocation
rules.rule_description: When the notice program is successfully found and invoked, the sanction notification is considered sent to downstream systems such as Claims and MCO, and processing continues normally.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Notifications Sent Successfully to Downstream Systems

acceptance_criteria.Given: The notice program name has been built and the system attempts to invoke it with the provider master record
acceptance_criteria.When: The notice program is found and successfully invoked without any exception
acceptance_criteria.Then: The notification is considered successfully sent to downstream systems (Claims and MCO) and the sanction processing for that provider record is complete

rules.rule_name: Handle Missing Notice Program Without Stopping Processing
rules.rule_description: When the dynamically built notice program cannot be found or invoked, the system logs a warning message identifying the missing program name and skips the notification step. The sanction status update already applied to the provider record is retained and processing continues with the next sanction record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Log Warning: Notice Program Not Available Skip Notification

acceptance_criteria.Given: The notice program name has been built and the system attempts to invoke it with the provider master record
acceptance_criteria.When: The notice program cannot be found or is unavailable (an exception occurs during invocation)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system logs a warning message containing the text 'NOTICE PGM NOT FOUND' along with the name of the missing notice program, skips sending the notification to downstream systems, retains the sanction status update already saved to the provider master record, and continues processing the next sanction record without stopping
